reasons: Every saved value that can change which designs fit is confirmed.
Stability, retention and strength need a built stand: approve a design, build it, then record its measurements.

Order: missing build requirements, then tape when no confirmed tape is usable, then sheets (thickness, width, height, usable area), each by stock ID.
